changes.title: Party cuts
items: Party areas no longer have the fairy-lit bushes and branches, LED cubes, standing mirror balls, UV-painted rocks and stumps, hanging fairy lights, party tents, inflatable rings or speaker stacks

changes.title: Chart phase order
items: The sea chart draws its islands in phase order, the first islands first, rather than spreading out from the one you've picked

changes.title: Legend text
items: A legend's quest is done when you put down the right kind's sigil inside its circle; the animal just walking in no longer counts
The legend circle's helper text is rewritten: shorter and plainer, and it says exactly what to do
